gen-gf-gugi-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Bold, distinctive Gugi has curves that match its stems exactly, with no stress anywhere. And Hedvig Letters Sans follows with small letters that stand almost as high as its capitals, and a wide gap where each c ends, so a long passage feels open and friendly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-heebo: Gugi draws with a pen that never shifts pressure or angle, and its terminals are cut open so the counters flow outward. Heebo sits under it with a deep central band and curves that stop short instead of closing in, which suits large, brief display lines.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-madurai: Gugi has lowercase letters that nearly reach its capitals and terminals cut open, so it looks distinctive from afar. Hind Madurai reads smoothly, with wide s curves and ribbon-like stroke ends.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-vadodara: Clean and spacious, Hind Vadodara keeps its thickness constant in every direction, with wide gaps in the rounded glyphs and big open e and a shapes. But Gugi is the bolder voice, its lowercase nearly as high as its capitals, and that gap in character is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and crisp, with lowercase bodies rising close to cap height. Gugi sits over it with a bold display voice and cut-open terminals, and the sturdy crossbars of Huninn keep the page grounded under that louder heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight looks like bent rope or tubing, with short ascenders and curve tails held well back from the body. Inter Tight gives Gugi, with its bold, open-terminal display letters, a restrained partner, and that difference is the strongest thing about them.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-karla: Karla fills its line with a gaping c opening and a middle band so deep the text looks stocky and friendly. Gugi's monoline skeleton and bold shapes make the sharper contrast.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-khula: Gugi finishes its terminals at the same width they began, giving big, bold shapes a distinctive punch. Khula does the quieter job, with curves that hold their mouths open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-kufam: Contemporary and bold, Gugi has open terminals and lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals. Kufam runs beneath it like a neon sign tube, with generously open e curves and bodies that dominate the line, so the two feel like loud and steady voices in one place.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend: Gugi's lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, and its terminals are cut open. Lexend answers with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, and that shared generosity of shape is the pair's strongest quality.
